scoring.shd_convention: missing/extra adjacency = 1; reversed common adjacency = 1; unresolved true adjacency = 1

limitations: Ground-truth generator only; no causal discovery method evaluated
Boolean SCMs and finite fixed graph/mechanism family catalog
